Do you want to develop new methods for quantitative modelling of the shallow subsurface and geological processes? The Geological Survey of Denmark and Greenland (GEUS) is looking for a researcher with a strong geological background and an interest in combining geoscientific observations, numerical modelling and scientific software development. 

  The position is a three-year, time-limited researcher position in the Department of Near Surface Land and Marine Geology (SURFACE) in Aarhus, expected to start on 1st of January 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter. 

  About the position 

  The position lies at the intersection of geology, geophysics, glaciology, numerical modelling and scientific software development. You will develop computational approaches that combine geological and geophysical observations with process-based and probabilistic models to create quantitative representations of the subsurface and glacial environments. 

  You will initially contribute to two ongoing research projects, ICESYNC and DREAM, while also taking part in research and development related to the national groundwater mapping programme and other activities at GEUS. 

  In ICESYNC, you will work with process-based modelling of erosion, sediment transport and deposition and investigate how modelled ice dynamics and sedimentary processes can be linked to geological and geomorphological observations. The work includes development of reproducible modelling workflows and pilot studies in Greenland and Denmark. 

  In DREAM, you will contribute to the development of a high-resolution probabilistic geological modelling framework based on drone-based TEM data. You will work with the integration of high-resolution resistivity models and their uncertainties with geological prior knowledge and other geoscientific data. The aim is to develop a semi-automatic, open-source workflow for constructing detailed geological voxel models and to test the approach using synthetic and field data. 

  Across these activities, you will work with numerical, probabilistic and process-based approaches to geological modelling and with integration of geophysical observations, geological data and process-based models. An important part of the position will be the development of reproducible computational workflows and scientific software for geoscientific analysis and modelling. You will also contribute to geological interpretation and modelling in research projects and applied activities, including the national groundwater mapping programme. 

  The position includes publication and communication of research through peer-reviewed papers, project deliverables, presentations and open-source software. You will also be expected to contribute to the development of new research ideas, project proposals and collaborations with Danish and international partners. 

  Who are you? 

  You hold a PhD, or have submitted your PhD before the application deadline, in geoscience, geophysics, computational geoscience or a closely related field. 

  We are looking for a researcher with a strong geological background and a good understanding of geological processes, combined with experience in quantitative geoscience. This may include numerical modelling, geological modelling, probabilistic or statistical methods, inverse problems, geostatistics or related approaches. 

  You should have a good understanding of geophysical data and their geological interpretation and strong programming skills, with experience in scientific software development, for example in Python, Matlab or a similar language. You should be able to work independently and systematically while contributing actively to an interdisciplinary research environment, and you should communicate well in written and spoken English. 

  Experience with TEM data, process-based modelling, 3D geological or voxel-based modelling, open-source scientific software or reproducible computational workflows would be valuable. Knowledge of Quaternary geology, glacial geology, sedimentology or groundwater geology would also be relevant, as would experience from externally funded research projects and preparation of research proposals. We do not expect applicants to cover all of these areas. 

  As Danish is the primary organisational language at GEUS, you should be prepared to learn Danish if you are not already a Danish speaker. 

  Meet your new colleagues 

  At GEUS, you will join the Department of Near Surface Land and Marine Geology, where we conduct research on a wide range of topics related to the processes, resources and geology of the upper 300 metres of the subsurface, both onshore and offshore. 

  Based at the university campus in Aarhus, the department consists of around 35 enthusiastic colleagues working in an interdisciplinary environment. We combine field observations, laboratory analyses, and advanced modelling to address scientific questions and societal challenges. 

  As part of the team, you will work alongside colleagues committed to scientific excellence, collaboration, and knowledge sharing. We work closely with public authorities, universities, and international research networks, providing a strong platform for developing your research, building collaborations, and making a meaningful contribution to both science and society. 

  A working environment with a focus on professional development and well-being 

  There are many good reasons why you should choose a working life at GEUS. 

  We are a diverse staff of about 300 committed employees. Trust and flexibility are keywords. The working environment is lively, informal and international. Our tasks are versatile and there are plenty of opportunities for you to influence the development of your task portfolio.

  We prioritise professional development, among other things by offering access to courses and other relevant activities. Socialising is also very important at GEUS, and we have a rich social life with a staff club, an art association and more. 

  At GEUS, we prioritise the well-being of every single employee. We prioritise that the Heads of Departments are close to the employees, and we have flexible working hours that allow you to organise your life so that there is time for what matters to you. If you need to work from home occasionally, that is also possible. 

  Furthermore, we have associated physiotherapists. 

  Salary and terms of employment 

  Salary and terms of employment are in accordance with the relevant trade union agreement. 

  The appointment area is the Ministry of Climate, Energy and Utilities and its institutions. 

  The Ministry of Climate, Energy and Utilities considers diversity to be an asset and encourages anyone regardless of gender, age, religion or ethnicity to seek the position. 

  Further information 

  If you would like additional information, please contact the contact Acting Head of Department Verner Brandbyge Ernstsen Verner vbe@geus.dk or Senior Researcher Anders Damsgaard on andam@geus.dk. 

  If you are an international applicant, you can read more about living and working in Denmark on GEUS’ website.  

  Are you interested? 

  If you are interested in the position, we would like to hear from you. The application must include a CV incl. your ORCID, a list of publications with a separate indication of articles registered in ISI Web of Science and any copies of individual publications of particular relevance to the position. Please enclose master's and PhD diplomas in either Danish or English as well as other material documenting qualifications at senior level. 

  Please apply for the position by clicking “Apply for position”. We must have your application at the latest on Sunday 15th of November 2026 (Danish time). 

  Applications or other material received after the deadline will not be considered. 

  The employment procedure 

  A professional assessment committee consisting of one internal and two external assessors at minimum senior researcher level will carry out an individual assessment of all applicants’ professional qualifications, and the applicants will be assessed as qualified or unqualified for the position. Afterwards, an internal employment committee will decide which of the professionally qualified candidates will be invited for a job interview. This procedure is in accordance with the “Order on employment and assessment of scientific staff at the Geological Survey of Denmark and Greenland § 4 and 7”.

We’re changing that. spektr gives regulated businesses one platform for onboarding, monitoring and investigations, with configurable workflows and AI agents that do the legwork. Product, Operations and Compliance can move together, with the control they need to grow.

We are looking for someone who is genuinely curious about how systems work, comfortable being new to things, and eager to grow fast in a high-bar environment.

**

• CI/CD Pipelines: Build and improve pipelines with GitHub Actions in a trunk-based development environment, so deployments stay safe and fast.

• GitOps: Work with ArgoCD-driven workflows and learn to own them end to end.

• Observability: Contribute to monitoring, alerting, and dashboards, helping us catch problems before customers do.

• Collaboration: Work closely with backend engineers and security stakeholders, applying cloud security best practices with AWS-native tooling.

• The Scale-up Mindset: You thrive in fast-moving environments and prefer building systems over following manuals.

• High-Agency Learner: You dig into problems you haven't seen before instead of waiting to be shown. You ask good questions and you don't ask the same one twice.

• Foundations: 1–3 years in DevOps, SRE, Platform, or backend engineering, or equivalent hands-on experience. A Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.

• Cloud & Containers: Working knowledge of AWS and Kubernetes. You don't need to be an expert yet, but you should be comfortable navigating both and understand what's happening underneath.

• Automation Instinct: Hands-on experience with Terraform or another IaC tool, and a preference for scripting something over doing it twice by hand.

• CI/CD Familiarity: You've worked with pipelines before, ideally GitHub Actions, and understand why deployment safety matters.

• Scripting & Systems: Comfortable with Linux, Git, and at least one scripting language (Bash, Python, or similar).

• Communication: You can explain what broke and why to an engineer who wasn't there.

**

• Observability: DataDog

 The Section for Computational and RNA Biology combines experimental and computational approaches to investigate RNA biology, gene regulation and genome-wide molecular processes. The position will be anchored in the Vinther research group and will contribute to the section's research activities, collaborations and supervision environment.

 The Staff Scientist will have scientific responsibility for the day-to-day implementation of MINDtheCAP and will independently plan and coordinate the work within the project's objectives, milestones, budget and reporting requirements.

• Coordinate project activities with laboratory technical staff and internal and external collaborators, and supervise students or junior researchers where relevant. 	
• Maintain research documentation and data-management practices and ensure compliance with laboratory safety, research-integrity and relevant institutional requirements. 	
• Prepare scientific publications, conference presentations, seminars, workshops, grant reports and relevant outreach activities. 	
• Develop follow-up research directions, collaborations and applications for further competitive research funding.   Because the work is research-driven, its detailed timing and sequence cannot be fully predetermined. Within the agreed scientific and institutional framework, the Staff Scientist will independently determine day-to-day priorities, experimental design and methods, the sequencing of experiments and analyses, and the coordination of collaborations.

 We are looking for a highly motivated and enthusiastic Staff Scientist with the following competencies and experience:

• A master’s degree in molecular biology, biochemistry, RNA biology or a closely related field.

• Experience with molecular biology techniques and laboratory work. Experience developing and optimising RNA-related methods, sequencing-library preparation and quantitative experimental controls is considered an advantage. 	
• Experience with or interest in analysing and interpreting transcriptomic data and in using or developing bioinformatic workflows. 	
• Interest in data analysis and bioinformatics. Experience with bioinformatic tools or workflows is considered an advantage. 	
• Experience preparing scientific reports, manuscripts and presentations is an advantage. Previous scientific publications are considered an advantage.  	
• Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively in a research environment within agreed milestones and budgets. 	
• Good written and oral communication skills in English.   Desirable experience and skills

   	
• Experience managing externally funded research projects and contributing to competitive funding applications. 	
• Experience coordinating interdisciplinary collaborations and working with molecular or neuronal cell-model systems. 	
• Experience supervising students, junior researchers or technical staff. 	
• Ability to work independently, solve scientific and technical challenges, and collaborate effectively across disciplines.   Place of employment
 The place of employment is the Section for Computational and RNA Biology, Department of Biology, University of Copenhagen, Copenhagen, Denmark.  For further information regarding the position, please contact Jeppe Vinther at jvinther@bio.ku.dk.

What you’ll do

New projects often call for new ways of measuring different proteins and peptides. You will spend a significant part of your time developing tailored methods, alongside analysing samples with established ones.

• Develop and implement new immunoassays for the proteins and peptides your collaborators need to measure.

Who you’ll work with

You will join Research Bioanalysis, part of Therapeutic Discovery within Research & Development, in Måløv, Denmark. What you can expect here

jobs.description:
Enterprise AI

Ballerup, Denmark

Your impact begins here

As Senior AI Engineer in Enterprise AI, you will turn strategic AI use cases into reliable products that create value across Novo. Working in cross-functional product teams in areas such as Commercial and Manufacturing & Product Supply, you will decide what each problem really needs, from conventional software to retrieval-grounded GenAI, and take it from prototype to production. Your work helps bring AI into everyday use for people living with serious chronic diseases.

What you’ll bring

You enjoy turning technology into business impact. You don’t need deep expertise in every part of AI engineering, but you do have a solid foundation in software delivery, production AI and cross-functional product work.

• 4+ years of experience building AI or software products. Demonstrated scope and capability matter more than tenure alone.

• Experience taking AI-centric applications from idea to production, and/or contributing to a product or platform team.

• Hands-on experience operating AI in production, including evaluation, monitoring, reliability and cost-performance trade-offs.

• A sound foundation in statistical and machine-learning concepts, with practical experience of modern AI application patterns.

• Strong programming and software engineering skills, including testing, documentation, APIs and CI/CD, preferably with GitHub.

• Experience using AI-assisted development tools and coding agents effectively in software delivery.

• Functional knowledge of modern AI interfaces and standards, such as model and tool integrations, MCP and observability approaches.

• An MSc, PhD or similar graduate degree in engineering, computer science, data science, statistics, machine learning or a related field. Candidates with a BSc and industry experience will also be considered.

You combine technical expertise with strong product sense and are comfortable clarifying needs with stakeholders and communicating technical choices to different audiences. You can take ownership of end-to-end AI delivery, make technical and product trade-offs, and ensure alignment throughout the process.

Beyond your technical expertise, we are looking for someone who is collaborative, curious and self-driven, with strong listening skills and a genuine interest in staying current as the AI landscape evolves.

Useful, but not essential

• Familiarity with pharma-specific AI domains, such as clinical NLP, drug discovery AI, regulatory automation or medical knowledge graphs.

• Experience with Databricks, Snowflake, Azure ML and Unity Catalog in an enterprise data and AI platform context.

• Knowledge of MCP (Model Context Protocol) server design and enterprise AI platform architecture patterns.

What you’ll do

You will be hired into AI Reinvent & Engineering, while much of your work happens in cross-functional product teams. A central part of the role is deciding whether a problem calls for conventional software or rules, optimisation, a predictive model, retrieval-grounded GenAI or a carefully bounded agentic workflow.

• Take AI- and ML-centric use cases from discovery and rapid prototyping through production and continuous improvement.

• Engineer the product-specific intelligence layer: data and feature transformations, decision logic, model and tool integrations, knowledge grounding, user-facing services, human-oversight controls and fallback behaviour.

• Partner with stakeholders and product managers to frame problems, agree priorities and define meaningful product outcomes.

• Build reliable, scalable, secure and observable products with appropriate testing, evaluation, documentation and CI/CD, using AI-assisted development tools and coding agents responsibly.

• Apply Responsible AI, data integrity, validation, traceability and auditability requirements in a regulated pharmaceutical environment.

• Work with the AI Foundation team to reuse shared capabilities and turn lessons from individual deliveries into reusable components and engineering patterns.

• Own substantial delivery workstreams, shape technical and product choices, and support less experienced engineers.

Who you’ll work with

You will join the AI Engineering Solutions team within AI Reinvent & Engineering, part of Enterprise AI in Enterprise IT, based in Ballerup, Denmark. The team brings together engineers with different strengths across statistics, machine learning, AI and software engineering.

Day to day, you will often work in product teams in Commercial, Manufacturing & Product Supply and other business areas, alongside product managers, domain experts, data scientists and engineers. Staying close to the problems keeps the work relevant, while links to the AI Foundation team keep engineering practices shared. We are cloud-native, working across Azure and AWS, Databricks, Snowflake, foundation-model APIs and modern AI application frameworks, and we value technical rigour, direct feedback and continuous learning.

What you can expect here

You will work in a multinational environment where your expertise is valued and trusted. You will keep growing through continuous learning and hands-on experience across business areas, with room to shape technical and product choices and to support colleagues as they develop.

At Novo Nordisk, we're not chasing quick fixes – we're creating lasting change for long-term health. For over 100 years, we've been driven by a single purpose: to defeat serious chronic diseases and help millions of people live healthier lives. This dedication fuels our constant curiosity and inspires us to push the boundaries of what's possible in healthcare. We embrace diverse perspectives, seek out bold ideas, and build partnerships rooted in shared purpose. Together, we're making healthcare more accessible, treating and preventing diseases, and pioneering solutions that create change spanning generations. When you join us, you become part of something bigger – a legacy of impact that reaches far beyond today.

Your impact begins here

As Digital Project Manager, you will lead a portfolio of high-impact AI and digital initiatives that create value across our Global Finance organisation. From initial scoping through implementation and stable operation, you will align stakeholders, clarify priorities and manage risks to keep delivery moving. Your work will turn promising ideas into practical solutions - quickly, effectively and at scale.

What you’ll bring

To succeed in this role, you will have:

• A master’s degree or equivalent in Finance, Business IT, Computer Science, Engineering, Business Administration or a related field.

• Minimum 3 years of project management experience, preferably in digital, IT, data or AI-enabled delivery.

• Experience working with cross-functional technical delivery teams, such as developers, functional experts and testers.

• Practical experience with Agile delivery, preferably as Scrum Master or Agile Project Manager.

• Experience managing multiple initiatives, dependencies and stakeholder groups in an international organisation.

• Strong facilitation, collaboration and stakeholder-management skills, and the ability to explain complex topics clearly and concisely at all organisational levels.

• A results-driven, structured and proactive way of working, with the ability to plan, prioritise, execute and follow up independently.

• Comfort with ambiguity, sound judgement and a willingness to challenge constructively while solving new problems with business and technical specialists.

• Fluency in written and spoken English.

Useful, but not essential:

• A certification in project management, Agile or Scrum.

• Experience implementing AI-enabled tools, automation or productivity improvements.

• Experience working with finance processes, stakeholders or solutions in a finance organisation.

What you’ll do

You will own delivery of digital and AI initiatives from idea to handover, keeping plans clear, risks visible and teams moving.

• Plan and deliver multiple digital and AI initiatives, turning business objectives into integrated project plans and a prioritised, actionable backlog.

• Design AI-enabled capabilities that streamline finance processes and support data-driven analysis and decision-making.

• Drive projects through scoping, development, testing, implementation and adoption, and follow up to make sure commitments are met with high quality.

• Facilitate Agile team events, such as planning sessions, stand-ups, reviews, retrospectives and backlog refinement, and remove impediments to keep delivery flowing.

• Set delivery KPIs and report transparently on progress, value, quality, risks, issues and dependencies. Spot risks early, agree mitigation actions and escalate decisions when needed.

• Build alignment across Finance and other areas, clarifying roles, expectations and resource needs, and supporting user readiness, adoption and benefit realisation.

• Coordinate quality, data privacy, IT security and testing activities with accountable specialists as well as resolving defects and incidents

Who you’ll work with

You will join Data & AI, where we develop and scale digital and AI solutions that improve finance processes, strengthen decision-making and create measurable business value. The team brings together business expertise, data, technology and responsible AI practices to turn opportunities into reliable solutions that can be adopted across the organisation. You will report to the Director of Data & AI.

Day to day, you will work with developers, functional experts and process owners to turn business needs into clear requirements and delivery plans. You will coordinate priorities across the Data & AI portfolio and partner with the Digital Innovation & AI team for delivery as well as stakeholders across Global Finance and Enterprise AI to move solutions from development to adoption.

The role has global reach. You will collaborate across functions, seniority levels, geographies, cultures and time zones, so an international mindset and effective remote collaboration matter. Limited national or international travel may be required, depending on project needs.

What you can expect here

You will work in an environment where digital and AI technologies and ways of working evolve quickly. You are trusted to create structure where things are unclear, make day-to-day delivery decisions and enable experimentation while keeping delivery disciplined.

You will grow through close work with technical and business specialists, share learnings across the department and the wider organisation, and help shape project management standards, templates and portfolio transparency within Data & AI. You will be supported to keep your development plan current, in a team that values learning, honest feedback and continuous improvement.

The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge, and relevant experience.

Incentives and Benefits: The salary package may include short-term and/or long-term incentives as well as other employee benefits based on position level, location, functional area, and relevant market benchmarks.

Start now

Your impact begins today. If you are ready to turn digital and AI ideas into progress for colleagues apply for the Digital Project Manager role by 1st November 2026.

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

The role

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our product team in Aarhus.

This is not a role where you only write code. You are a systems developer. A real part of your time goes into discovery, meaning analysis and design: understanding the problem, shaping the solution, and deciding what is worth building. The rest goes into delivery.

We work AI-augmented. Modern AI tools are a natural part of how we design, write and review software, so more of the typing is handled for you. That makes the harder, more valuable work the judgement: what to build, how it fits together, and whether it holds up as the platform grows. We use AI to move faster, and we believe people are what make sure we build the right things.

Your work will reach hundreds of thousands of people across the Nordics: job seekers navigating labour market reforms, employment professionals adapting to new digitalisation strategies, and the institutions managing that change. Talking with the people who use the platform may be part of the job, so that what you build stays grounded in real needs.

What you will work on

Candeno serves municipalities, unemployment funds, and educational institutions across Denmark, Norway, Sweden, and Finland. The platform has three sides: candidates navigating the labour market, advisors guiding them through digitalisation and compliance workflows, and companies recruiting talent. One platform, many contexts.

We are actively building and improving core parts of the platform. You will:

Discovery (analysis and design)

• 
Work with product managers, designers and stakeholders to understand real user problems before we commit to building. AI helps us move fast, so the harder work is knowing what is worth building.

• 
Explore options, weigh tradeoffs, and decide what to build and how.

• 
Contribute to architecture and system design that keep the platform scalable and maintainable.

Delivery (development and operations)

• 
Design, build and maintain robust, scalable features across the platform.

• 
Write clean, maintainable code, using AI tools where they help and applying judgement to what they produce.

• 
Review code and designs, test and debug complex issues, and give constructive feedback.

• 
Operate what you build: CI/CD, containers and cloud, and refactor as the platform grows.

Quality and craft

• 
Meet security standards and protect user data in a data-sensitive sector.

• 
Share knowledge and mentor other engineers on craft and good practice. This is technical mentoring, not people management.

Who we are looking for

You are a senior engineer who is as comfortable in the problem as in the code. Your foundation is strong delivery, and your edge is at the front of the process: you know how to find the right problem before jumping to a solution, and how to do it at a pace that keeps up with a team that ships.

You will need:

• 
5+ years building software, ideally SaaS.

• 
Strong with PHP and Laravel, and with JavaScript and React.

• 
Experience with containerisation (Docker, Kubernetes) and running services in the cloud.

• 
A considered approach to AI in your workflow. You use modern AI coding tools well, and you review what they produce critically.

• 
Strong system and product thinking. You can take part in discovery, not only delivery.

• 
Clear communication. You can explain a technical tradeoff to a PM, a designer, and another engineer, and make it feel simple.

• 
A degree in computer science, engineering or similar, or an equivalent proven track record.

The kind of person who does well here:

• 
Curious about the problem, not only the code.

• 
Ownership mindset. You follow a problem all the way through.

• 
Comfortable making decisions without a perfect foundation, and honest about the tradeoffs when you do.

• 
Direct. You share work early, give feedback clearly, and push back when something is not right.

What the first six months look like

After one month

You understand the platform architecture, our discovery and delivery process, and the team. You have taken ownership of your first delivery tasks and you are part of discovery conversations and team ceremonies.

After three months

You are leading delivery of key features and contributing actively to discovery, helping shape solutions and technical direction for upcoming work. AI tools are a fluent part of your daily work.

After six months

You show leadership in system design and architecture decisions and influence technical direction. You own discovery for meaningful pieces of work, from problem to buildable plan, and you mentor other engineers on craft and good practice.

Working at Candeno

We are a scale-up. That means real ownership, real impact, and a product that is still being shaped by the people who work on it.

We are based in Aarhus, and this is an on-site role. The team is small, cross-functional, and works closely together. You will have real ownership of your work and close proximity to product, design and the rest of engineering.

We are direct and focused on doing the right thing for users. We share work early and expect you to do the same.

What we offer

• 
Pension scheme and health insurance

• 
5 extra days off after 2 years of seniority (10 in total)

• 
Daily lunch from Meyers Madhus

• 
A shared milestone programme that celebrates successes big and small

• 
An active social life: team events, clubs, and an engaged social committee

Before you apply

This is a fully on-site role in Aarhus with no remote option. You must already have the right to work in Denmark and be able to be in our office every working day from your start date. We do not offer visa sponsorship or relocation support. Applications that do not meet these conditions will not be considered, so please only apply if all of them apply to you.

A first interview, a deeper conversation about your experience and the role

About Candeno

Candeno is a Nordic employment technology company based in Aarhus.
